shots.text: Sunscar Canyon is red rock. The Stoneborn live in cities carved into its walls. Its Warden, Orrok, sleeps in the mountain at its head, under Grundhallow.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Red rock canyon by torchlight, cliff cities in terraces, giant stone faces of old kings.

shots.text: Orrok had gone mad, and the canyon turned on the Stoneborn. Its walls broke off and walked. Every oath carved in its cities broke at once, and the oath-breakers turned to stone and marched. Their Herald was Gorrath, the Stoneborn general who once held the Kharum Pass for a month.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Canyon walls cracking; boulders standing up and walking. Stoneborn with granite growing through their skin marching among them. At their head a giant Stoneborn general with a square hole in his chest: Gorrath.

shots.text: Stone doesn't feel a blade. It feels lightning. Give me towers that throw it, and I'll do the rest.
shots.speaker: kaela
shots.art_note: Kaela on Thunderclap at the canyon rim, watching the walls move below.
